boundary: An actual representative-independent Selmer-to-ideal-class-group homomorphism and p-torsion codomain, a linear map on the same valuation submodule, and the unit-quotient injection/kernel-image equality/right surjection proving the group short exact sequence. The same cyclotomic constant has an actual class image unchanged by integer rescaling; conditional on its original Selmer membership and zero class image, the same constant is an actual integer-ring unit times a field pth power, preserving its nonzero vector and nontrivial unit quotient class. Original Frey Selmer membership, Galois equivariance and eigenspace transport, arithmetic class/unit vanishing, local pth powers/resonant geometry and tower iteration remain open; general hno is unfinished.
